commands.name: list add
commands.summary: Add or restore one item on the person's shopping list. It adds to the quantity of a matching item still on the list (same ingredient and unit); a removed or cleared matching item comes back at the added quantity, not on top of its old one.

args.name: name
args.description: What to buy, such as eggs or flour.

quantity.description: How many or how much, as a number above 0. Leave it out when it doesn't matter.

unit.description: The unit for the quantity, such as grams, cups or cans. Leave it out for a plain count.

category-key.description: Optional. The aisle's category key, such as produce or pantry.

icon-key.description: Optional. The item's icon key, such as wheat or package.

idempotency-key.description: Optional. Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, such as after a timeout, and the item is added once.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose list, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts on their own list.

connection approve.reason: You can't approve access to the person's Spoonjoy account; only they can.
connection approve.how: with Approve access on the connection page, after typing the code you showed them
